text: 宁德时代公告，2026年9月11日首次以集中竞价交易方式回购A股股份60.43万股，占总股本0.0131%，成交价330.15元/股-331.61元/股，成交总金额约2.00亿元（不含交易费用）。
text_en: CATL announced that on September 11, 2026, it repurchased 604,300 A-share shares for the first time through centralized bidding, accounting for 0.0131% of total share capital, at a transaction price of RMB 330.15 per share to RMB 331.61 per share, with a total transaction amount of approximately RMB 200 million (excluding transaction fees).
